item.title: Mike Flanagan’s 10-Episode Netflix Thriller Masterpiece Is Everything ‘Carrie’ Should Have Been
item.description: Mike Flanagan knows how to make horror. He also knows how to make serialized TV . His most recent show is a mix of most of the things we’ve come to love about him: his bond with Stephen King, his skills as an adapter, his great eye for casting, and his ability to deliver pathos. But one key thing is missing: fear.

item.title: Sega’s Most Influential Platformer Deserves Its Big Remake Moment Next
item.description: With The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and even Star Fox recently proving there is still an appetite for remakes done right, other game publishers are likely looking at their backlogs for inspiration. Sega, no stranger to fantastic franchises, suddenly finds itself once more in an enviable position. It has a bunch of great old games ripe for revival, and several of them seem capable of making a mark again.

item.title: All vault locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Vaults are locked locations around the map that contain rare chests and a sprite chest in Fortnite Chapter 7's mini season .

item.title: All map fragment locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has added a new collectible to find throughout the season: map fragments . These map fragments will be added periodically during the season, and you'll get a special reward for finding them all.

item.title: All sprites in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Sprites have taken over another season with their inclusion in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, " Treasure Hunters ." These sprites work functionally the same way as they did in the last seasons: find them around the island, level them up, and extract them to master them. Mastering sprites will unlock different rewards, like sprite dust and cosmetics.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Opening Weekend Box Office Breaks A Foreign-Language Film Records
item.description: Godzilla Minus Zero had a strong opening weekend, grossing more at the domestic box office than any live action foreign-language film before it. On top of that, a higher percentage of people sought out premium screens, like IMAX, to watch it even more than they did for The Odyssey earlier this year.

item.title: Speedrunners Already Breaking The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Remake
item.description: Speedrunners have had their hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for a couple of days now, and some funky tricks have already been discovered. In particular, the remake's addition of a jumping mechanic has enabled new speedrunning tactics that just weren't possible in the Nintendo 64 original or its 3DS remake.
